summary: React Three Fiber Director viewport and exact-time headless capture.

key_files.src/code-components.tsx: Browser compilation and rendering of trusted single-file Director TSX with react/three imports. This is not a sandbox.
key_files.src/DirectorViewport.tsx: Shared interactive and headless scene, including code instances and optional default lighting.
key_files.src/headless-entry.tsx: Exact-time capture entry; component errors reject capture. The per-frame limit comes from directorCaptureTimeoutMs (one minute up to 1920x1080, proportional to pixels above).
key_files.src/headless-render-boundary.ts: Publication gate and the one render-loop tick for headless capture. The loop must stop drawing once the frame is published: a software rasteriser cannot keep up with frames issued every animation frame, and the backlog delays the PNG readback and outlives the page.
